The '''Academy Administration building''' at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Ossus Academy]] was a building that was located down a path leading from the courtyard at the [[Clarity Gate|entrance]] to the academy grounds. It was established to house the administrators that oversaw the work of the non-Jedi employed at the academy.

With the temporary abandonment of the Academy, the building remained unused until the Jedi returned. It would later be destroyed during the [[Massacre at Ossus]].
